source_refs.note: 5. Plastic and Solid Waste: a main subheading of 33.3 Common Water Pollutants, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 250-254.

blocks.text: Samandaron aur doosri water bodies mein plastic aur solid waste (thos kachre) ki pollution ek barhta hua environmental crisis (mahol ka bohran) hai. Har saal karoron ton plastic, jaise botlein, shopper, machhli ke jaal aur microplastics (plastic ke bohat barik particles), daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein phenka jata hai. Organic cheezon ke bar-aks plastic qudrati taur par nahi galta (biodegrade nahi hota); yeh chhote chhote tukron mein toot kar sadiyon tak mahol mein rehta hai.

Samandari janwar aksar plastic ko khana samajh lete hain; use nigalne se dam ghut sakta hai ya andar chot lag sakti hai, jo jaan-leva ho sakti hai. Kabhi purane machhli ke jaal aur samandar ki tah ke doosre malbe mein phans kar be-shumar samandari jandaar, jaise kachhuay, dolphins aur parinde, zakhmi ho jate ya mar jate hain. Microplastics food chain mein bhi dakhil ho chuke hain, is liye insani sehat par in ke asar ki fikr hai. Solid waste (thos kachra) waterways (pani ke raaste) band karta hai, aquatic habitats (pani ke jaandaron ke ghar) bigarta hai aur pani ki quality girata hai.

blocks.prompt: i. Heavy metals ke sources batayein.
blocks.explanation: Industry ka ganda pani, mining aur waste ka ghalat phenkna. Mercury: koyla jalana, sone ki kaan-kani, thermometer aur battery ki factories. Lead: leaded petrol, lead ke pipes, lead-acid batteries, paints. Cadmium: metal plating, plastic stabilisers, phosphate fertilizer ki impurities.

blocks.prompt: ii. Tel ka girna (oil spill) samandari zindagi ke liye kaise khatarnak hai?
blocks.explanation: Tel ki tah dhoop rokti aur oxygen exchange kam karti hai; mammals grooming karte hue zehreela tel nigal lete hain; machhliyon ko hydrocarbons se lamba nuqsan hota hai; mangroves, coral reefs aur beaches kharab hote hain.

blocks.prompt: iii. DDT jaise pesticides “non-polar aur pani mein na ghulne wale” hain, phir bhi pani ko ganda kar ke sehat ke sangeen masail paida karte hain. Samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: DDT ki bohat thori miqdar pani mein ghulti hai, aur runoff (behte pani) mein mitti ke particles se chipak kar bhi pani tak pohanchti hai. Yeh charbi mein ghulta aur der tak khatam nahi hota, is liye machhliyon ke charbi wale tissues mein jama hota hai aur food chain ke har qadam par barhta hai (biomagnification). Is tarah oopar ke jandaar aur insan zyada miqdar lete hain.

items: Microbiological pollutants: E. coli, Salmonella, Giardia; cholera, typhoid, dysentery, hepatitis A; ubalne se jaraseem marte hain, doosri pollution nahi.
Heavy metals: Hg (Minamata disease), Pb (anaemia), Cd (Itai-itai); WHO ki hadd Table 33.2 mein.
Pesticides aur PCBs: hormones ka bigar, cancers; eutrophication: algal bloom aur dead zones; tel ki tah; plastic aur microplastics.
